 disk into the disk drive,

You take a rock the

size of a softball.

Your time is up. You have
failed to defeat me. You
are mine until the end of
time, and it's not going
to be fun!

The Firey lends you his

arm, then goes on his way.

You have discovered a very large

bracelet. You wonder if there

are giants in the Labyrinth!

The cleaning machine turned your

log into a smooth black plank!

You pocket a brilliantly

shimmering crystal ball.

The Firey offers his head

and then wanders away.

Being careful not to wake him,

you remove the goblin's helmet.

You pull a tarnished brass

key out of the door.

The Firey gladly gives you

his leg, then hobbles away.

With much effort, you take

the large, heavy log.

You now have a luscious,

fully ripened peach.

You now own a bottle of Ven
Perfume, known far and wide for
its intensely sweet smell.
In fact, the label says, "The
sweetest smell in the world!"

You pull the knocker's

ring out of its mouth.

This rule book lists all of the
Labyrinth's rules. It's so
boring that you have fallen
asleep for 10 minutes. You don't
even remember any of the rules!

You have found a

large pair of shears.
One hour later...

You eat the peach and fall

into a deep sleep...

You float out of the oubliette

to your freedom!

You smell very sweet. Very very 
sweet. So sweet it's unbearable.

The perfume counteracts the Bog 
stench. You smell just like new.

Using more perfume 
just makes it worse!
You can't carry any more of that.
You have nothing.
Nothing happens.

The rule book says, "One must 
stay in an oubliette forever."
